pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-01-09. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-01-09 at 1,803.50 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 10.06 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 2,194 million. The top gainer of the week was Safari Retail (SYN).

The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned.
